title: 挑战 6 · 二极管防反接保护
summary: 在电源入口串一个二极管：电池接反时电路不会通电。
description:
电池接反（+ 和 − 对调）可能损坏电路。最简单的保护：在电源 + 后面串联一个普通二极管（diode）。
• 正接：二极管导通，只“吃掉”一小段电压。硅二极管的模型是 0.65 V 再加一个 0.8 Ω 的小电阻，这里的电流只有十几毫安，所以压降约 0.66 V；
• 反接：二极管截止，没有电流流过，后面的电路安全。

要求：+9V → 二极管（anode 朝电源，cathode 朝电路）→ 470Ω → 绿色 LED → GND。
二极管上有色环的一端是负极（cathode）。

点「检查我的电路」时会测二极管负极的电压：它应该比电池电压低 0.6–0.7 V。

en.title: Challenge 6 · Diode reverse-polarity protection
en.summary: Put a diode in series at the power input: if the battery is connected backwards, no current flows into the circuit.
en.description:
Connecting a battery backwards (+ and − swapped) can damage a circuit. The simplest protection: put an ordinary diode in series right after the supply +.
• Connected correctly: the diode conducts and takes only a small slice of the voltage. The silicon diode model is 0.65 V plus a small 0.8 Ω resistance; the current here is only about a dozen milliamps, so the drop is about 0.66 V;
• Connected backwards: the diode blocks, no current flows, and the circuit after it is safe.

Task: +9V → diode (anode toward the supply, cathode toward the circuit) → 470Ω → green LED → GND.
The end of the diode with the painted band is the cathode (negative).

When you press “Check my circuit”, the diode's cathode voltage is measured: it should be 0.6–0.7 V below the battery voltage.
hints: Like an LED, a diode has a direction: current flows from the anode to the cathode (the banded end).
The diode's anode can go straight into the red + rail.
tests: LED on, about 8.3V after the diode

hints: 二极管和 LED 一样有方向：电流从 anode 流向 cathode（色环端）。
二极管的 anode 可以直接插在红色 + 轨上。
